Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
RawProcessId
The operating system’s internal PID. For matching, use the UPID fields which guarantee a unique process identifier
Protocol
Values:
IP (0)
ICMP (1)
IGMP (2)
TCP (6)
UDP (17)
IPV6 (41)
GRE (47)
ICMPV6 (58)
UNKNOWN (255)
InContext
A boolean field which indicates whether the event containing the field was emitted in the context of the process or thread that generated
the event.
ConnectionFlags
A ULONG field which is a socket bit mask. It has the following values:
RAW_SOCKET (1) - raw socket
PROMISCUOUS_MODE_SIO_RCVALL (2) - promiscuous mode RCVALL
PROMISCUOUS_MODE_SIO_RCVALL_IGMPMCAST (4) - promiscuous mode RCVALL_IGMPMCAST
PROMISCUOUS_MODE_SIO_RCVALL_MCAST (8) - promiscuous mode RCVALL_MCAST
Values:
RAW_SOCKET (1)
PROMISCUOUS_MODE_SIO_RCVALL (2)
PROMISCUOUS_MODE_SIO_RCVALL_IGMPMCAST (4)
PROMISCUOUS_MODE_SIO_RCVALL_MCAST (8)
IS_LOOPBACK (16)
LocalAddressIP6
RemoteAddressIP6
LocalPort
RemotePort
ConnectionDirection
Values:
DIRECTION_OUTBOUND (0)
DIRECTION_INBOUND (1)
DIRECTION_NEITHER (2)
DIRECTION_BOTH (3)
DIRECTION_UNKNOWN (4)
FfcNetworkState
Network connection state, normalized for mac/linux/windows.
Values:
